Hi all,

We’re on for the Site A private deployment this Friday 04/03 (maintenance window 03:00–07:00 UTC). This thread is to confirm the safety checklist and to coordinate the smoke execution/runbook ownership. Please review the attached smoke checklist and network diagram and confirm the following by EOD today: 1) firewall/NAT changes staged and approved, 2) BGP peer(s) validated for new prefix advertisement, 3) Kestrel has applied the ACL exceptions for health checks, 4) runbook owners aligned for rollback and post-check validation.

Attachments: siteA-private-deploy-smoke-checklist.pdf, siteA-network-diagram.png

Quick asks:
- Dev: can you confirm the KV cache prewarmed snapshot will be applied at T-15?
- Kestrel Ops: confirm collector endpoints for telemetry (ingest.redwood.kestrel) are reachable after the cutover.

I’ll run the smoke checklist during the window; Marissa, would you own the smoke execution and results consolidation? Karthik — please standby for SLA verification and escalation.

Thanks,

Quick confirmations from infra:
- KV prewarm: scheduled at T-15 (script id: PREWARM-37), snapshot stored in s3://redwood-ops/kestrel/siteA/prewarm-20270403.
- Firewall/NAT: rules staged in Kestrel's firewall console (change request #KST-4321); expected apply at T-20. No asymmetric NAT expected.

I attached a short runbook excerpt for the prewarm and a health-check verification snippet. If we see >2% 5xx during token-gen step, plan is to revert model variant to q4_legacy and re-route traffic to standby pool (rollback steps 4–6 in attached).

Status update (post-deploy smoke run) — executed 2027-04-03 03:12–03:58 UTC

Summary: majority of checks passed. Key highlights and actions below. Full CSV attached (smoke-results-20270403.csv).

Passes:
- Control-plane API basic health: 200 OK / p95 latency 38ms
- Embedding endpoint: sample vectors generated and validated against golden set (cosine > 0.995)
- Telemetry ingestion: all three collectors accepted test payloads

Findings (minor):
- Token-generation step saw a transient 503 spike (03:23 UTC) during first warm-batch — correlated with a missed affinity tag on one GPU pod. Action: Dev rolled a pod replace at 03:27; subsequent runs stable. Root cause: autoscaler did not pick up affinity label on one rescheduled replica.
- Network: one backend NTP server timed out from agent in rack B; failover to backup NTP occurred automatically. Logged to KST-NET incident tracker.

Actions completed:
- Pod replace executed and verified (logs: PREWARM-37/replace-20270403.log)
- Telemetry ingest validation signatures stored in drive link below
- Post-smoke regressions: none observed in model outputs for the seeded eval prompts

Attachments: smoke-results-20270403.csv

Thanks team — excellent execution and quick remediation. I’m closing the loop with a short post-deploy readout and next steps: 

1) Status: Site A private deployment successful. Critical SLOs within expected ranges after remediation.
2) Follow-ups assigned:
   • Dev Patel — file a post-incident runbook update for affinity label regression (due 2027-04-09).
   • Marissa Cole — finalize smoke-results CSV and upload to Kestrel drive, include brief mitigation notes (done).
   • Kestrel Ops (Jordan/Alex) — confirm NTP remediation schedule and close KST-NET incident.
3) Compliance: we will add the smoke-results CSV and network diagram to the evidence bundle for the SOC2 tracker (link above).
4) Backout/drill: schedule a game-day in two weeks to rehearse rollback steps (Marissa/Dev to propose dates).

Thanks again — noted a few doc updates (runbooks and checklist) that we’ll version and ship. If nobody objects I’ll mark the task as closed in the customer PO and archive the test artifacts.
